snippet.title: Everdream Village | Teaser Trailer (PC, PS, Switch, Xbox)
snippet.description:
Everdream Village is coming to life! 

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3569950

Build your ideal, cozy farm in a living village. Form bonds with fellow villagers to lend a hand as you grow crops, care for animals, and craft a corner of paradise. Sail across enchanted islands to discover new resources and adventures along the way.

Coming to Steam Early Access in 2025 with full release set for PC, PlayStation, Switch,  and Xbox.
